floorPlans.label: Emaar: Vindera full floor plans
floorPlans.introduction: Compare the three- and four-bedroom townhouses in four-home and six-home clusters, across both facade styles. Each complete sheet shows both floors, the published area breakdown, cluster position, key plan and developer notices.
floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a Vindera style and cluster position
floorPlans.note: Totals include suite, garage and balcony or terrace areas; they are not plot sizes. Style and cluster position can change the area, and mirrored homes retain their own key-plan sheets. Small differences of 0.01 sq ft may arise from rounded components. Furnishings, planting and finished specifications remain subject to the signed plans and agreement.
